Original head/joints and old family methods remain exact.

Fly has the widest/longest fan, RunFly/PowerFly are next and Swim/RunSwim stay compact. Fresh swatches101/100 follow physical ray halves. This shallower opaque fan approximates the source membrane, including narrower Swim/mixed breadth. Original parent yaw and pivots unchanged.

dark_fly_path_069.marker_policy: Original dot core and all expression joints/visibility exact; six same-bone closed protrusions interpret observed Dark spikedball, never a Hero halo.
dark_fly_path_069.tail_policy: Two slim connected closed rearward/upturned boxes on the existing tail__cube_0 and joint; original tail__cube_1 base unchanged. Scoped prone stem folding pivots about an interior point of that unchanged base, preserving its attachment.
